10. Suppose the Correia-Teles model of section 4.6.3 is modified so that output is
equal to fðnÞ, where f is a standard neoclassical production function exhibiting positive but diminishing marginal productivity of n. Show that if fðnÞ 1⁄4 na for a > 0,
the optimality condition given by (4.70) continues to hold.
